comment: Source of demo-bundle.zip. Rebuild with: uv run python scripts/make_demo_bundle.py. Every case is invented; no real patient. 'demo' says what a careful annotator or reviewer should do; it is not written into the bundle.

texts.text:
Neuromuscular clinic letter

A 9-year-old boy was referred because of difficulty climbing stairs and frequent falls. Examination showed proximal muscle weakness of the hip and shoulder girdle. He rises from the floor using his hands. The weakness has progressed over the past year. Serum creatine kinase was markedly elevated at 12,400 U/l. Echocardiography showed no cardiomyopathy. A maternal uncle had muscle weakness and used a wheelchair from the age of 12.

Synthetic demonstration case. No real patient.

proposals.demo: correct; add 'The weakness' as a second mention
wrong assertion: the text says no cardiomyopathy, so Absent
wrong experiencer: the uncle, so Family member

texts.text:
Headache clinic letter

A 28-year-old woman has had migraine with visual aura since her teens. Attacks occur about four times a month and last up to a day. During attacks she has a throbbing headache with nausea. She also reports a constant ringing in both ears. Examination showed no ptosis and normal eye movements. Her mother also has migraine.

Synthetic demonstration case. No real patient.

proposals.demo: wrong term: replace Hearing impairment with Tinnitus (HP:0000360)
wrong assertion: no ptosis, so Absent

texts.text:
Developmental clinic letter

A 4-year-old boy was assessed for delayed speech. He speaks only single words and has poor eye contact. A diagnosis of autism was made by the developmental team last month. Hearing tests were normal. He is clumsy but has no ataxia. His older sister has epilepsy and still has seizures despite medication.

Synthetic demonstration case. No real patient.

proposals.demo: wrong experiencer: the sister, so Family member

texts.text:
Movement disorders clinic letter

A 67-year-old man reports a tremor of the left hand at rest for two years. Examination showed resting tremor and bradykinesia on the left. He has noticed a reduced sense of smell. His wife reports that he may act out his dreams at night; this needs further assessment. He had a depressive episode in 2015, which has resolved.

Synthetic demonstration case. No real patient.

proposals.demo: too general: replace Tremor with Resting tremor (HP:0002322)

proposals.quote: act out his dreams at night

texts.text:
Neuropädiatrischer Arztbrief

Ein 6-jähriges Mädchen wurde wegen wiederholter Krampfanfälle vorgestellt. Seit dem Säuglingsalter besteht eine muskuläre Hypotonie. Die Sprachentwicklung ist verzögert. Eine Mikrozephalie liegt nicht vor. Der Vater hatte als Kind ebenfalls Fieberkrämpfe.

Synthetischer Demonstrationsfall. Kein echter Patient.

Neuropaediatric letter

A 6-year-old girl was referred because of recurrent seizures. She has had muscular hypotonia since infancy. Her speech development is delayed. There is no microcephaly. Her father also had febrile seizures as a child.

Synthetic demonstration case. No real patient.

proposals.demo: correct: the father, as a child

texts.text:
Neurologischer Arztbrief

Ein 45-jähriger Mann berichtet über zunehmende Schluckstörungen und Doppelbilder am Abend. Bei der Untersuchung fand sich keine Ptosis. Die Kraft der Arme lässt bei Belastung nach. Sein Bruder hat eine Myasthenia gravis.

Synthetischer Demonstrationsfall. Kein echter Patient.

Neurology letter

A 45-year-old man reports increasing difficulty swallowing and double vision in the evening. Examination showed ptosis. The strength of his arms decreases with exertion. His brother has myasthenia gravis.

Synthetic demonstration case. No real patient.
texts.demo: translation error: 'keine Ptosis' became 'showed ptosis'; correct it to 'showed no ptosis'

proposals.demo: follows the translation error: Absent after the correction

proposals.quote: strength of his arms decreases with exertion

Neuropädiatrischer Arztbrief

Ein 14-jähriger Junge hat seit zwei Jahren eine Gangataxie. Hinzu kommen eine Skoliose und Hohlfüße. Die Muskeleigenreflexe sind erloschen. Das Hörvermögen ist normal.

Synthetischer Demonstrationsfall. Kein echter Patient.
